clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Den in the Valley of Trials, Magga welcomes new arrivals. The orc lives in Durotar and greets Horde travelers beginning their journey through the valley.

Young orcs and Darkspear trolls first meet the wider world in the Valley of Trials. Near the Den, Magga greets those arriving in the valley. Trainers and recruits keep busy nearby, while Magga helps bring the small camp together.
